lazytrae.description: LazyTrae state, evidence, handoff, and local context MCP server — exposes 15 tools including heuristic symbol/reference/docs/dependency helpers

grep_app.description: Experimental optional grep_app public-code MCP. Enable with lazytrae tooling enable grep_app.

context7.description: Optional Context7 library documentation MCP. Enable with lazytrae tooling enable context7; credentials stay in the host environment.

filesystem.description: Filesystem access MCP server — optional template pinned to a reviewed version

git.description: Git operations MCP server — disabled manual option. The former package name is no longer published; install and configure a reviewed Git MCP server explicitly before enabling it.

playwright.description: Browser automation MCP server via Playwright — optional template pinned to a reviewed version

ast_grep.description: Structural code search via ast-grep — disabled manual option. The former package name is no longer published; install and configure a reviewed MCP server explicitly before enabling it.

lsp.description: Managed read-only LSP bridge — opt in with an explicit target and tooling root: lazytrae lsp --target <absolute-project-path> --tooling-root <absolute-owned-root>. It provisions only TypeScript/JavaScript or Python providers when requested and never mutates the target project.

lazytrae.description: LazyTrae MCP configuration template for v0.16.0-alpha.1. The 'lazytrae' server runs through the installed CLI and provides 15 state, evidence, handoff, and local context tools. Optional servers provide additional capabilities and degrade gracefully when not configured.
lazytrae.note: Required: false servers are optional and will not cause errors if unavailable. Disable unwanted servers by setting 'disabled': true.
